title: The Month Before GTA 6: October 2026's Top Game
description: Looking at the bustling gaming landscape right before GTA 6, featuring the latest Game of the Month poll results from Push Square for PS5 releases.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Calm Before the Storm: October in the Shadow of GTA 6

For gaming enthusiasts worldwide, October holds a very specific significance—it is famously known as the month right before GTA 6. Following an equally manic September, the past 31 days delivered an incredibly busy lineup of new PS5 releases, making the latest Game of the Month poll more intriguing than ever.

## A Crowded Field on PS5

According to gaming outlet Push Square, players cast their votes in a crowded field of releases during a remarkably intense period. As developers and publishers rushed to launch their titles before the industry's upcoming massive shift, the PS5 library saw a continuous wave of new games hitting the market throughout the month.

## Industry Dynamics Ahead of the Launch

While the looming presence of GTA 6 dominates industry conversations, the October release calendar proved that developers were far from slowing down. Analysts note that witnessing a month unfold right on the doorstep of a generational titan like GTA 6 provides a unique lens through which to view current player engagement and software momentum.

## Editor's Take

Navigating the month before GTA 6 is no small feat for players or developers. Push Square's latest poll captures a vibrant moment in time when the gaming community balanced heavy anticipation for the upcoming blockbuster with a packed slate of autumn releases.
